data_description.smart_trip: Short intermediate stops are automatically merged into one trip.
data_description.charging: Charging status sensor (available only for FordPass electric vehicles).
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: The usable battery capacity of the vehicle. Default: 77 kWh.
data_description.journey_home_zone: Zone whose arrival can end a journey.
data_description.journey_home_timeout_minutes: The journey ends only after the vehicle has remained in the journey base for at least this amount of time. 0 minutes ends it immediately.
data_description.journey_max_gap_hours: Maximum time between two trips before a new journey starts. This value is used as a fallback when no journey base can be used.
data_description.home_tariff_enabled: Automatically calculates costs for charging sessions at the Journey base.
data_description.home_tariff_summer_price: Price per kWh for charging sessions from 1 April to 30 September.
data_description.home_tariff_winter_price: Price per kWh for charging sessions from 1 October to 31 March.
data_description.home_tariff_currency: Currency used for automatically calculated home charging costs.

import_charging_sites.title: Import charging location database
import_charging_sites.description: Select a Ford Triplog charging location database in JSON format. The existing database is backed up automatically and replaced after successful validation.

data_description.charging_site_file: For example charging_sites_de.json, charging_sites_at.json or charging_sites_ch.json.

import_charging_sites_success.title: Import successful

download_charging_sites.title: Download charging location database
download_charging_sites.description: Select the country whose charging locations should be downloaded directly from OpenStreetMap. The existing database is backed up automatically before activation. The process may take several seconds or minutes.

data_description.charging_site_country: A new charging location database is created for the selected country and activated immediately.

download_charging_sites_success.title: Charging location database activated successfully
download_charging_sites_success.description:
The charging location database for **{country} ({country_code})** was successfully downloaded from OpenStreetMap, processed and activated immediately.

**Download and processing**
- OSM elements: **{downloaded_elements}**
- Normalized charging stations: **{normalized_stations}**
- Detected charging locations: **{searchable_sites}**
- Geohash cells: **{index_cells}**
- Skipped elements: **{skipped_elements}**

**Database**
- Size: **{database_size}**
- Total duration: **{duration}**

The new database is immediately available for charging-location detection.

user_charging_site_edit.description: The fields correspond to the data model of the OSM charging-station database. Multiple connectors can be selected, and custom brand values are supported. Available data is prefilled for a detected charging location.

pending_charging_sites.description: Select one of the {pending_count} detected charging locations. Coordinates and available station data are prefilled.

journey_update.title: Update journeys
journey_update.description: Creates only missing journeys in the optional date range.

journey_rebuild.title: Rebuild journeys
journey_rebuild.description: Deletes existing journeys in the date range and recalculates them.

journey_delete.title: Delete journeys
journey_delete.description: Deletes journeys. Trips and charging sessions remain unchanged.

journey_result.title: Journey action completed

charge_management.title: Charging sessions
charge_management.description: Select one of the {charge_count} archived charging sessions.

data_description.charge_selection: The list shows date, location, charged energy and stored costs.

charge_cost_edit.title: Edit charging costs

data_description.cost_total: Optional total for simple or older entries. When detailed cost components are entered, the total is calculated automatically.
data_description.currency: Three-letter currency code, for example CHF or EUR.
data_description.action: Save costs or remove all stored cost information.
data_description.energy_billed_kwh: Energy shown on the invoice, charging station, or charging app. Used to calculate charging losses.
data_description.blocking_fee: Fee for occupying the charging point.
data_description.other_cost: Any cost that does not fit another category.
